<Heading
  as={"h1"}

  children={"List a campaign run's goals"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/run/{id}/goals"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the goals of a campaign run with their verdict and each attack run's outcome on them, ordered by goal index. Filter by `goal_index`, `category`, `subcategory`, `verdict` or a `search` in the goal text, and narrow to one attack run with `run_id`. Paginated with `page` and `page_size` (at most 1000). Accepts a login token or an API key (not a run token). Every response has a weak `ETag`: send it back as `If-None-Match` to get `304` without a body while nothing changed.
